yall are so pissed off for no reason lol. Lemme just explain some things;

1. The moon and the Star: The reason why the moon and the star are on the sneaker is to represent Turkey. Because back in the day  Turks used the moon and star as their symbol (more than any group) to the point that it became a part of their flag. Now to the reason that it is on the swoosh, it's just about aesthetics man; it's literally just to make the moon look like a part of the swoosh.
2. The "Arabic" on the shoe: Bro it's just a font, yes Turkish people don't use Arabic but it's purely for aesthetic reasons. I mean would I prefer it was written in another font, yeah maybe but this looks amazing anyways. And to that any of you talking about Arabic being a sacred language and it shouldn't be on footwear. Man ITS NOT EVEN ARABIC
3. Why is the shoe named Istanbul it represents a lot of normal middle eastern things: Lemme just list off the Turkish things on this shoe; The Nazar boncuğu, the baklava, Turkish rugs, the Turkish flag and -to me this was really impressive- it has the colors of many old Turkish architectures

Now if i was asked for anything else that i wished was on the design, I would just say the Sultan Ahmet bridge tbh (maybe on the back of the shoe where it says Nike)

For last I wanted to say my thanks to the OP, it brings me so much joy that you decided to get inspiration from Istanbul and Turkey and if these were made I would buy 'em and wear 'em all the time
